data.name: Muaddal
data.gender_notes: Muaddal is used as a male name in Islamic naming traditions.
data.long_meaning: Derived from the Arabic root ‘A-D-D-L’, which means ‘to help’ or ‘to support’. This name is often given to children who are expected to assist and support their families and communities. The name Muaddal carries the meaning “A Helper or Supporter” and is chosen by families in Islamic traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Arabic tradition and is also used in Arabic, Urdu, Persian. Parents who choose Muaddal usually hope their child will grow to embody a helper or supporter and live with faith, good character and purpose.
data.spiritual_meaning: A name that represents helping and supporting others in the path of righteousness.
data.etymology: Muaddal belongs to the Arabic linguistic tradition and is used in Islamic naming. Its recorded meaning is “A Helper or Supporter.”
data.numerology_meaning: In Pythagorean numerology the letters of Muaddal total 2, giving a life-path number of 2. Number 2 is linked with Moon and with the qualities of harmony, sensitivity and partnership.

in_arabic.name: مؤدل
in_arabic.long_meaning: مؤدل هو اسم عربي يأتي من الفعل أودل، الذي يعني الترتيب أو التدرج، ويشير إلى الشخص الذي يتمتع بالمرتبة أو الدرجة العالية في المجتمع، وله أهمية دينية وثقافية في التراث الإسلامي

in_urdu.name: موئدل
in_urdu.long_meaning: موئدل ایک عربی نام ہے جو فعل اودل سے ماخوذ ہے، جس کا مطلب ہے درجہ بندی یا درجہ بندی کرنا، اور یہ شخص کو ظاہر کرتا ہے جو معاشرے میں اعلیٰ درجہ یا مرتبہ رکھتا ہے، اور اسلامی روایت میں اس کی مذہبی اور ثقافتی اہمیت ہے

in_hindi.name: मुआद्दल
in_hindi.long_meaning: मुआद्दल एक अरबी नाम है जो क्रिया औदल से लिया गया है, जिसका अर्थ है स्तर या दर्जा देना, और यह व्यक्ति को दर्शाता है जो समाज में उच्च स्तर या दर्जा रखता है, और इस्लामी परंपरा में इसका धार्मिक और सांस्कृतिक महत्व है

in_pashto.name: مؤدل
in_pashto.long_meaning: مؤدل د عربی نوم دی چې د اودل کړی څخه اخیستل شوی، چې د درجہ بندۍ یا درجہ بندۍ معنی لري، او دا شخص ښیی چې په ټولنه کې لوړ درجہ یا رتبه لري، او په افغان/پښتو دود کې دا د مذهبي او کلتوري اهميت درلودونکی دی

in_english.name: Muaddal

Naming a child Muaddal is a way of instilling these values within them from a young age, encouraging them to be dutiful members of their families and communities. It is a name that inspires a sense of responsibility, emphasizing the importance of helping and supporting others.
data.spiritual_significance: From a spiritual perspective, the name 'Muaddal' reflects the essential human quality of being a support system for one another. It is a reminder that we are all connected, and that our actions can have profound impacts on the lives of those around us. By choosing to live up to the name 'Muaddal', individuals are aligning themselves with the divine quality of compassion and selflessness, and are cultivating a deeper connection with the divine. The name provides a spiritual anchor, guiding its bearers to act in ways that uplift and support others, ultimately contributing to a more peaceful and harmonious world.
